activeSlice.scope: Expose the exact critical Hunter V1 dependency failure diagnostics captured during shadow control execution so a non-comparable control identifies discovery/judgment phase, source, safe failure kind and optional HTTP status without changing comparability or rollout policy.
successCriteria: Critical V1 control failure diagnostics preserve phase, source, safe failure kind and optional HTTP status.
Enrichment-only failures remain excluded from critical failure details as required by production fallback semantics.
Cohort screening diagnostics include the critical failure details alongside existing measured values.
No comparability predicate or rollout threshold changes.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
The same 3x3 pre-gate is rerun on the exact merge SHA before any 30-pair gate.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: GitHub ephemeral control had evidenceCount=20, costUsd=0.014, modelInvocationCount=0 and criticalDependencyDegraded=true. The safe HunterFailureDiagnostic kind/status was captured internally but not surfaced.
